wLineRecord.derivation: No class a/b/c candidate precedes the E3 marker (Menthol, Camphor and essential oils are not on the closed lists; Linalool/Limonene follow the cap); no alphabetical run. The marker Fragrance (Parfum)@17 is itself a class a candidate: (i) Sodium Coco-Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> W-line = cap = 17, no fallback code.

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C5: the defining anionic is Sodium Coco-Sulfate@2 (alkyl sulfate type) with two prominent buffers (Babassuamidopropyl Betaine@4, Cocamidopropylamine Oxide@16) and no reinforcing strong anionic. C3b: Cocamidopropylamine Oxide is the buffer that brings C5 down to moderate (with one buffer C5 yields strong), so confidence is at most moderate and the neighbor is strong.

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful system - the cationic conditioner Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine@10 with Polyquaternium-4@12 - plus the prominent liquid oil Sunflower Seed Oil@6 and Glycerin@3. C2 is not met: no silicone (the oil may take its place) but no pearlizing/fatty route. Counter-signal: Polyquaternium-4 is a low-substantivity polymer and the chassis is cleansing-led (sulfate, essential oils, vinegar); low and high are not equally realistic - low is the realistic neighbor (and the lower value per N-ALT tie rule).

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: W-RICH is established (material Sunflower Seed Oil@6, before the W-line Fragrance@17, converging with cationic deposition Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine@10 / Polyquaternium-4@12), but the C5 sodium coco-sulfate chassis gives moderate reset, so the rich route does not reach high; the convergence route is not convincingly met because the routes are light (liquid oil, low-charge PQ-4). W-RICH recorded as counter-signal, high as neighbor.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Three deposition families (payload_lipid, cationic_conditioner, cationic_polymer) and W-RICH are present; the amidoamine conditioner is a genuinely substantive cationic.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: An amidoamine conditioner plus a prominent oil plausibly leaves bounded residue (not lightweight), but an alkyl-sulfate chassis with buffers resets it and no silicone or waxy lipid is present.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs W-RICH with weak reset or converging persistent systems that reset does not offset; reset is moderate (alkyl sulfate) and the converging routes are light (liquid oil, PQ-4).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH is formally present; the oil and amidoamine levels are unknown and could move the band to high.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Three deposition families (payload_lipid, cationic_conditioner, cationic_polymer) and W-RICH are present; the amidoamine conditioner is a genuinely substantive cationic.
